newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Stg/mark consolidates for push to 2.84.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Stg/mark consolidates for push to 2.84.

text.p: Sterling is set to consolidate on Thursday, harnessing momentum for an eventual jog uphill towards 57-month highs above 2.84 marks, said analysts.
Sterling/mark was well supported in Europe after bouncing from a 2.8180-mark low on Wednesday, and analysts said it was now ensconced in a consolidating pennant formation.
"It is suggesting a move towards the 2.84-mark level," said Nico Bakker, technical analyst at ABN AMRO.
Bakker said that while the pennant, forming at the highs on June 13, is a consolidation pattern, sterling could get a lift after venturing out of recent trading ranges.
At 0807 GMT, sterling/mark was trading at 2.8410/20 against 2.8382/87 in late Europe on Wednesday. Cable stood at $1.6380/90 against $1.6400.

Sterling/mark pushed out of its sideways consolidation range to highs of 2.8440 on June 12, and barring its flop to 2.8180 mark lows on Wednesday, it has managed to remain hovering just below fresh 57-month highs of 2.8445 marks. Beyond the 2.8445 highs, analysts note major channel resistance at 2.85 marks.
Cable is set to remain rangebound on Thursday, with a slight positive bias after its close above a sideways pennant formation on Wednesday, said chartists.
